anchor.exact_quote: intended to supplement our prepared remarks during today's call

units.text: Jonathan Neilson: Good afternoon, and thank you for joining us today. On the call with me are Satya Nadella, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer; Amy Hood, Chief Financial Officer; Alice Jolla, Chief Accounting Officer; and Brian DeFoe, Deputy General Counsel and Corporate Secretary. On the Microsoft Investor Relations website, you can find our earnings press release and financial summary slide deck, which is intended to supplement our prepared remarks during today's call.

anchor.exact_quote: It is now my pleasure to introduce Jonathan Neilson, Vice President of Investor Relations

units.text: Operator: Greetings, and welcome to the Microsoft Fiscal Year 2026 Fourth Quarter Earnings Conference Call. As a reminder, this conference is being recorded. It is now my pleasure to introduce Jonathan Neilson, Vice President of Investor Relations. Please go ahead.

anchor.exact_quote: On this call, we will discuss certain non-GAAP items

units.text: On this call, we will discuss certain non-GAAP items. The non-GAAP financial measures provided should not be considered as a substitute for or superior to the measures of financial performance prepared in accordance with GAAP. They are included as additional clarifying items to aid investors in further understanding the company's fourth quarter performance.

routing_notes: 财报电话会：Prepared Remarks 与 Q&A 分段读取，发言者角色随每段保留
主持人/IR开场介绍不是业务指引；分析师提问不是管理层陈述
non-GAAP 全局说明随所有局部数字保留

facts.objective: 发言角色决定陈述归属：开场由 VP of Investor Relations 引介（Chairman&CEO、CFO等出席），新闻稿与补充材料是 prepared remarks 的补充而非替代
must_preserve: 角色=Operator / VP of Investor Relations / Chairman&CEO / CFO 分列
阶段=开场（引介）与 prepared remarks、Q&A 分开
范围=网站新闻稿与slide deck是补充材料
must_not_assert: 不得把IR引介词当业务指引或业绩陈述
不得把分析师提问中的说法归给管理层
不得把网站/第三方takeaways当电话会原文

facts.objective: non-GAAP 为全call适用的口径限定：不替代GAAP，作为补充说明；相关局部数字必须带此限定
must_preserve: 限定=non-GAAP不作为GAAP的替代或更优
作用域=整个电话会（全局），随局部事实保留
must_not_assert: 不得丢弃non-GAAP限定后单独引用数字

not_evaluated: 角色归属/全局限定的语义执行：交ROOT（execution_status=NOT_RUN_ROOT_INTEGRATION）
Q&A 正文与具体问答语义不在本case（属问答语义，见 syn_exit_no_answer 同类规则）
与 real_us_release_subscription 的重复事实识别在证据层做，本包不复制全文
